verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a reversible USB-A plug (community mentions), a 'works in any USB port' claim, an NFC variant, and colored cases. It never establishes a USB-C model, a nano/low-profile form factor, or a keychain design, so only part of the lineup story is supported. Missing for 10: documented USB-C model, nano/low-profile form factor, keychain form factor, first-party lineup or spec documentation.
